label: Orders
caption: NASSER, ALI M. V. MURPHY, JEDIDIAH I.
text: The application to vacate the stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice Alito and by him referred to the Court is granted. The October 6, 2023 order of the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas, case No. 1:23- cv-1170, is vacated. Justice Sotomayor, Justice Kagan, and Justice Jackson would deny the application.
